description: Raw source rounds for NJ store data, in the order they were collected. Restored from file corruption on 2026-07-05: stores-nj.json and this file had multiple JSON objects concatenated without a wrapping array (missing commas), which silently broke NJ store fetches on the live map (the fetch's .catch(() => []) swallowed the parse error). Every round below was recovered and preserved.

rounds.source: New Jersey Grocery Stores – All 21 Counties (COMPLETE)
rounds.description: Verified grocery, supermarket, convenience, bodega, and specialty food stores across all 21 New Jersey counties. Includes market share data, top-rated stores per county, and verified locations from multiple sources.

counties.notes: Atlantic County has 274,534 residents (2020). Top-rated stores include Bagliani's Market (4.8 stars, 1,900+ reviews) and multiple ShopRite locations (4.2 stars) [citation:4]. ShopRite is the dominant chain in Atlantic County.

Bergen County has 955,732 residents (2020). ShopRite leads with 15% market share, followed by Ahold Delhaize (9%), Albertsons (8%), Amazon (6%), and H Mart (6%). Aldi, Target, Lidl, Trader Joe's, and Walmart each have 3-5% market share [citation:1]. Top-rated stores include Trader Joe's of Westwood (4.7 stars), Trader Joe's Paramus (4.6 stars), Trader Joe's of Edgewater (4.6 stars), Stew Leonard's (4.6 stars), and Maywood's Marketplace (4.6 stars) [citation:4]. Nicholas Markets has a location in North Haledon serving Bergen County [citation:5].

specialty_stores.address: 1068 High Mountain Road, North Haledon, NJ 07508

counties.notes: Burlington County has 461,860 residents (2020). Top-rated stores include Trader Joe's of Marlton (4.7 stars), Wegmans of Mount Laurel (4.6 stars), ShopRite of Burlington (4.3 stars), ShopRite of Hainesport (4.3 stars), and ShopRite of Delran (4.1 stars) [citation:4].

Camden County has 523,485 residents (2020). Top-rated stores include Wegmans of Cherry Hill (4.6 stars), Aldi of Stratford (4.5 stars), ShopRite of Berlin (4.3 stars), ShopRite of Chews Landing (4.3 stars), and Whole Foods of Cherry Hill (4.3 stars) [citation:4].

Cape May County has 95,263 residents (2020). Top-rated stores include ShopRite of Marmora (4.4 stars), ShopRite of Rio Grande (4.3 stars), Acme of Wildwood (4.1 stars), Acme of Cape May Courthouse (4.1 stars), and Acme of North Cape May (4.1 stars) [citation:4].
Cumberland County has 154,152 residents (2020). Top-rated stores include Elmer IGA (4.2 stars), Acme of Pennsville (4.1 stars), and Acme of Woodstown (4.0 stars) [citation:4].

Essex County has 863,728 residents (2020). ShopRite leads with 16% market share, followed by Albertsons (9%) and Amazon (5%) [citation:1]. Top-rated stores include ShopRite of Essex Green (4.3 stars), Aldi of Bloomfield (4.3 stars), ShopRite of Brookdale (4.3 stars), Whole Foods of West Orange (4.3 stars), and ShopRite of Livingston (4.3 stars) [citation:4]. Nicholas Markets has a location in Cedar Grove serving Essex County [citation:5].

Gloucester County has 302,294 residents (2020). Top-rated stores include Verchio's Produce Outlet in Sewell (4.5 stars, 4,500+ reviews), ShopRite of West Deptford (4.3 stars), Aldi of Woodbury (4.3 stars), ShopRite of Sewell (4.3 stars), and ShopRite of Glassboro (4.2 stars) [citation:4].

Hudson County has 724,854 residents (2020). Top-rated stores include ShopRite of Hoboken (4.3 stars), Acme of Stadium Plaza (4.2 stars), ShopRite of Metro Plaza (4.1 stars), Extra Supermarket of Jersey City (4.1 stars), and Acme of Newport Plaza (4.1 stars) [citation:4]. Manta lists 120 grocery businesses in Jersey City alone [citation:7]. NJ WIC data confirms numerous authorized vendors in Hudson County including Shop Rite in Bayonne, Pathmark in Jersey City, Stop & Shop in Jersey City, Bravo Supermarket, and many mini markets [citation:11].

counties.notes: Mercer County has 387,340 residents (2020). ShopRite leads with 14% market share, followed by Aldi (8%) and Walmart (6%) [citation:1]. Top-rated stores include Trader Joe's of Princeton (4.7 stars), Wegmans of Princeton (4.6 stars), Whole Foods (4.4 stars), ShopRite of Hamilton Square (4.3 stars), and ShopRite of Lawrenceville (4.3 stars) [citation:4].

Middlesex County has 863,162 residents (2020). ShopRite leads with 15% market share, followed by Aldi (9%), Walmart (9%), Target (7%), Ahold Delhaize (6%), Albertsons (4%), and Patel Brothers (4%) [citation:1]. Top-rated stores include Wegmans of Woodbridge (4.8 stars - tied for highest in NJ), Trader Joe's of North Brunswick (4.6 stars), Whole Foods of Metuchen (4.4 stars), ShopRite of Woodbridge (4.3 stars), and ShopRite of North Brunswick (4.3 stars) [citation:4]. Nicholas Markets has a location in Colonia serving Middlesex County [citation:5].

Monmouth County has 643,615 residents (2020). ShopRite leads with 19% market share, followed by Aldi (9%), Target (9%), Stop & Shop (7%), Acme (7%), Lidl (6%), Super Foodtown (6%), and Walmart/Sam's Club (6%) [citation:8]. Top-rated stores include Wegmans of Ocean Township (4.6 stars), Trader Joe's of Shrewsbury (4.6 stars), ShopRite of Shrewsbury (4.5 stars), ShopRite of Howell (4.4 stars), and ShopRite of Wall (4.4 stars) [citation:4].

Morris County has 509,285 residents (2020). Albertsons leads with 18% market share, followed by ShopRite (16%), Target (9%), Walmart (9%), Ahold Delhaize (7%), and Amazon (5%) [citation:1]. Top-rated stores include Trader Joe's of Denville (4.7 stars), Wegmans of Parsippany-Troy Hills (4.6 stars), Trader Joe's of Florham Park (4.6 stars), ShopRite of Greater Morristown (4.4 stars), and ShopRite of Rockaway (4.4 stars) [citation:4].

Ocean County has 637,229 residents (2020). ShopRite leads with 17% market share, followed by Stop & Shop (11%), Walmart (11%), Acme (9%), Aldi (9%), and Target (6%) [citation:1][citation:8]. Top-rated stores include Trader Joe's of Brick (4.6 stars), Seasons Lakewood - Kosher Supermarket (4.6 stars), Aldi of Toms River (4.3 stars), ShopRite of Route 37 (4.2 stars), and ShopRite of Fischer Bay (4.2 stars) [citation:4].

Passaic County has 524,118 residents (2020). Top-rated stores include Trader Joe's of Wayne (4.6 stars), C Town of Passaic (4.3 stars), ShopRite of Passaic on Paulison Ave (4.2 stars), and Super Fresh (4.2 stars) [citation:4]. Manta lists 110 grocery businesses in Paterson alone [citation:3]. Nicholas Markets has a location in Township of Washington serving Passaic County [citation:5]. NJ WIC data confirms numerous authorized vendors in Passaic County including Pathmark, Shop Rite, and Stop & Shop locations [citation:11].

counties.notes: Salem County has 64,837 residents (2020) - the lowest population in New Jersey. Top-rated stores include Elmer IGA (4.2 stars), Acme of Pennsville (4.1 stars), and Acme of Woodstown (4.0 stars) [citation:4]. This county has the fewest grocery options.

Somerset County has 345,361 residents (2020). Top-rated stores include Trader Joe's of Bridgewater (4.7 stars), Wegmans of Bridgewater (4.6 stars), Whole Foods of Bridgewater (4.4 stars), ShopRite of Bound Brook (4.3 stars), and ShopRite of Somerville (4.3 stars) [citation:4].

Sussex County has 144,221 residents (2020). Top-rated stores include ShopRite of Sparta (4.5 stars), ShopRite of Byram (4.4 stars), ShopRite of Montague (4.2 stars), ShopRite of Newton (4.1 stars), and ShopRite of Franklin (4.0 stars) [citation:4].

Union County has 575,345 residents (2020). Top-rated stores include Trader Joe's Westfield (4.7 stars), Aldi of Union (4.4 stars), Lidl of Union (4.4 stars), ShopRite of Linden (4.3 stars), and ShopRite of Union (Route 22) (4.3 stars) [citation:4].

Warren County has 109,632 residents (2020). Top-rated stores include ShopRite of Greenwich (4.4 stars), ShopRite of Washington (4.2 stars), Stop & Shop of Phillipsburg (4.2 stars), Weiss of Hackettstown (4.2 stars), and ShopRite of Mansfield (4.1 stars) [citation:4].
